CVE-2007-0671.n: Microsoft Office Excel Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
CVE-2007-0671.act: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
CVE-2007-0671.d: Microsoft Office Excel contains a remote code execution vulnerability that can be exploited when a specially crafted Excel file is opened. This malicious file could be delivered as an email attachment or hosted on a malicious website. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability by creating a specially crafted Excel file, which, when opened, allowing an attacker to execute remote code on the affected system.

CVE-2007-5659.n: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
CVE-2007-5659.d: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a PDF file with long arguments to unspecified JavaScript methods.

CVE-2007-3010.n: Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
CVE-2007-3010.d: masterCGI in the Unified Maintenance Tool in Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise Communication Server allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands.
